identity.research_session_id: server-issued, workspace + retained paper identity; refresh/restart/new graph cannot reset it
identity.agent_run_id: server-issued tenant-scoped mapping to private graph thread
identity.operation_id: durable action identity; all retries and children share it

parser_interface.storage: Owner2 retains original bytes and registers parser references; Owner4 supplies bounded parsing/rendering, never approval or database writes
parser_interface.status: interface proposed; confirm actual parser signature before registration

model_factory.owner3_responsibility: reserve every physical request/retry/auxiliary operation through the single ProviderLedger before dispatch; preserve tool binding, metadata and cancellation
model_factory.owner2_responsibility: validate authority, grant action scope, meter tool/turn limits, require registered metered adapter in live mode; do not reserve each physical request a second time
model_factory.controlled: explicit local adapter; no external request/provider-attempt identity or actual tokens

paper_proposal.citations: each proposed field binds a disclosed page identity and exact excerpt
paper_proposal.materialization: human reviewed exact values + explicit assumptions use ordinary immutable dataset/problem creation; no computation approval
paper_proposal.unsupported: paper evidence review remains available; scientific execution unavailable/manual, no model substitution

events.content: safe summaries/references only; no raw reasoning, credentials or fabricated transcripts

review_interrupt.resume: authenticated current workspace access + unchanged context + matching canonical approval; interrupt itself confers no authority
